title: Existing 40 Preset Conversion

preset_contract.content_reference_rule: Each preset references the completed ENV-02 profile instead of copying its comprehensive prose.
preset_contract.archetype_rule: Primary and secondary archetype composition must exactly preserve the ENV-03 crosswalk.
preset_contract.overlay_hint_rule: Deferred overlay family hints indicate likely projection into ENV-11/12/13 only and are never executable overlay identities.
preset_contract.context_rule: Broad setting/state/style concepts such as post-apocalyptic and cyberpunk remain preset context unless narrower reusable conditions are separately authored.
preset_contract.refinement_rule: A source-backed preset remains usable while later tranches refine parameters, split combined profiles, or promote condition traits into governed overlays.

conversion_rules: Each of the 40 completed source-backed environment profiles becomes exactly one GM-ready preset identity.
Preset identity retains a direct immutable reference to the source Environment Definition and ENV-02 effective completion record.
Existing profile content is referenced, not copied, so modularization does not create a second drifting prose authority.
Source-backed distinguishing traits remain source trait notes until later tranches have enough authority to normalize them.
No concrete weather, planetary, physical-condition, magical, supernatural, or multiversal overlay is authored in ENV-05.
No creature distribution, Habitat Signature detail, runtime schema, encounter runtime, SCL behavior, or environment UI implementation is authorized.
